subject: Distance sampling and photo identification methods

messages.author: 4c918a5d3235174b
messages.subject: Distance sampling and photo identification methods
parts:
Hello everyone!

I am in a little confusion when I compared distance sampling and photo identification methods for studying Australian humpback dolphin (Sousa sahulensis). Is it possible to combine both methods and use MRDS for data analysis? If so, can I do the field data collection (distance and photo-ID) at the same time in every effort allocated?

Any insights are open and would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you!
Rama.

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Distance sampling and photo identification methods
parts:
Rama

I do not know of any published work integrating photo-id data into a distance sampling (MRDS) framework. Without published methodology, I don't know how data should be collected nor how such data would be analysed.

I found an example where dual survey methods were carried out synchronously, but the data were analysed separately:

https://seawatchfoundation.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2012/08/39.-distance-sampling-combined-with-photoid-as-monitoring-tool-2006.pdf
